title.narrative: Young Women for Change: A National Advocacy Summit for a Sexual and Reproductive Health Rights Agenda

description.narrative: As long-time partners, Akbayan Youth and Danmarks Socialdemokratiske Ungdom (DSU) are steadfast in their commitment to our shared values of equality, freedom, and solidarity. In a world where patriarchal norms and values continue to harm various sections of society, it is imperative for activists globally to resist and respond. This pilot project acknowledges the necessity for young women to unite and lead the resistance against the detrimental effects of inadequate sexual reproductive and health rights education in the Philippines. This project aims to collectivize young women across the Philippines and train them as young campaigners and educators of sexual reproductive health rights, responding to the alarmingly increasing rate of teenage pregnancy in the country.
